prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one complete flat, opaque landscape 16:9 event poster for an adult neighbourhood upcycling hobby afternoon, suitable for a local cultural centre and community digital screen. Friendly and mature, with a clear information route at 720-pixel display width. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Whole visual design: warm opaque gouache-like illustration, economical dark ink contours, light apricot background and a broad cream communal-table plane indicated by a few diagonal boundaries. Deep aubergine typography. The picture provides neighbourly generosity; type remains firm, upright, clean Korean sans with regular, open counters and consistent word spacing. Restrained painted edge variation on objects and clothing; smooth quiet grounds behind every text line. No brush lettering.

Composition uses a 720×405 proportional planning grid; scale everything together to the native output. A compact two-line Korean title at x24/y20, about 40px at this display scale and 48px line pitch, left aligned. Break copy entry 1 after its third word. A modest 18px English line at x24/y127. Activity entry 3 at x24/y169 in two 20px lines, wrapping immediately after the middle dot. These identity/purpose lines lead across to a contiguous attendance block at x275/y150: entries 4–7, each one line, about 21px, 28px pitch. Participation entries 8–11 form another contiguous block stepping diagonally down and right at x408/y279: each one line, about 19px, 28px pitch, with generous right and bottom margins. Dark readable facts remain stronger than painterly texture. No tilted or perspective text. Keep central-to-lower-right open space free of hands, fabric pattern or boundary strokes. Match factual pitch so the attendance and preparation groups visibly continue through this corridor, rather than appearing as disconnected captions.

Substantive illustrated scene: upper-right, roughly x465–720/y12–185, two ordinary middle-aged adult neighbours in indigo and terracotta clothing face one another across a short segment of the table. Crop their busts naturally near the right edge, leaving their faces and the action clear. They share one finished fabric pouch about 80px wide at the planning scale. The left giver grips its upper side seam with one hand, their forearm and wrist visibly attached to their own torso. The right receiver supports the pouch bottom with one open palm, their own wrist and arm separately visible. Use only these two action hands; the other arms are outside the crop. Keep pouch contact boundaries clean, simplify fingers with economical painted contours and show a proper sewn mouth, side seams and bottom seam. A second, different muted leaf-green finished pouch rests nearby on the table as another offering. No crowded workshop, elaborate room perspective or additional sewing action.

Lower-left, roughly x12–242/y250–398, a substantial recognisable worn cotton T-shirt lies flat on the same simply indicated table. Show neckline, both sleeve-to-body junctions and the broad torso panel. Its cream torso has a broad moss-green diagonal repair strip rising from lower-left toward upper-right plus one small indigo horizontal stripe with a visibly offset junction crossing that strip. The exchanged finished pouch is assembled from this torso panel: it must visibly retain BOTH the diagonal moss-green repair and the small offset indigo stripe junction on its front, adapted to the smaller sewn pouch. Only the torso fabric is reused: the pouch has no collar or sleeves. These distinctive corresponding details connect source clothing to assembled result, while the clear supported exchange connects making to sharing. Keep this garment/exchange relationship prominent at usage size, not reduced to decorative icons. The diagonal table plane connects the opposite picture corners around the open factual space without inventing a prescribed workshop sequence.

Print the following eleven copy entries exactly once each and nothing else. Preserve all letters, Korean word spaces, numbers, the middle dots, colons, comma and time-range en dash. Layout wrapping may occur only as specified above; each fact stays one line. No labels or numbers from this spec are printed:
1. 입던 옷의 다음 장면
2. REMAKE & SHARE
3. 티셔츠를 파우치로 · 완성품 나눔
4. 2027.01.16 토요일
5. 14:00–16:30
6. 성산 생활문화센터
7. 13:40부터 입장
8. 참가비 3,000원 · 도구 제공
9. 사전 신청 · 정원 18명
10. 깨끗한 티셔츠 한 장 지참
11. 바느질이 처음이어도 괜찮아요

Finish as one independent full-bleed poster with opaque colour across the entire canvas. Preserve readable full practical information at 720px width and mature daytime warmth. No added copy, logos, pseudo-print, watermark, QR, wavy frame, decorative tape, childish craft styling, photograph of a poster, tablet surround, mockup, contact sheet, multiple poster variants or comparison panels.
